claim: Patchline ships an independently-audited reduction in real-world migration incidents across many organizations. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the independently-audited claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make audited-incident-reduction-field-gate`.
